text: 小蛙一开始把歪碟架在岸边当三脚架，碟口却让画面全歪了。它索性换到低处，把小相机稳在一根横枝后，设好延时，自己蹦到镜头前。你连续四天饭后散步，今天记下小溪边小树枝转弯的两次观察差异；它这一回想让你看看自己的泥塘弯道。小蛙朝镜头张开宽嘴，一只前足抬起来，身后的水面上，一截小枝正经过弯口。咔嗒。它跑回来瞧，发现照片里自己占得比弯道还大，便留下这张：‘先看见我，再看右边那个小弯！’歪碟带回低棚，照片副本夹在上一张泥塘叶尖照片旁。

home: 家仍在泥塘花圃边的低棚，两根细枝支起棚顶，花圃与浅水围在外侧。棚下宽叶床是休息处，床旁的脚印扁泥垫可活动，歪口小碟带回原处；门口第一次蹭跳的泥印与空蛋壳保留。宽叶床旁的收藏处并存旧泥塘叶尖照片副本与本次延时自拍副本，只添照片，不搬家。

request.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single opaque landscape 3:2 PHOTO that a fantasy pixel frog companion intentionally took for its user with a camera timer. Reference image 1 locks identity: same cute adult warm terracotta orange frog, cream yellow belly, wide mouth, two protruding eyes, four fleshy short legs, mature webbed hind feet, complete short pale yellow petal-like BIOLOGICAL folds around back, no hat. Viewpoint is user's direct view through the camera. Frog is close in foreground facing and looking directly into lens, knowingly posing with a broad open smile and ONE front foot raised in greeting. Strong camera awareness; spontaneous off-center framing and foreground perspective. Behind its right side the frog's own little muddy pond turns around reeds, with a small twig at the bend. This is a personal self-timer picture addressed to you, not a third-party frog watching a pond. Cute cartoon pixel scene, crisp few-color blocks and compact living body. Rectangular printed photo with narrow plain white photographic border, no stamp or postcard markings, no caption, no writing. The camera is out of frame and frog holds no object. Natural connected legs with natural occlusion, preserve organs and adult form, no green special form.
